018/** Module class for controlling a REV Robotics Pneumatic Hub. */
019public class PneumaticHub implements PneumaticsBase {
020  private static class DataStore implements AutoCloseable {
021    private final int m_module;
022    private final int m_handle;
023    private final CANPort m_busId;
024    private int m_refCount;
025    private int m_reservedMask;
026    private boolean m_compressorReserved;
027    private final int[] m_oneShotDurMs = new int[PortsJNI.getNumREVPHChannels()];
028    private final Object m_reserveLock = new Object();
029
030    DataStore(CANPort busId, int module) {
031      m_handle = REVPHJNI.initialize(busId.value, module);
032      m_module = module;
033      m_busId = busId;
034      m_handleMaps[busId.value].put(module, this);
035
036      final REVPHVersion version = REVPHJNI.getVersion(m_handle);
037      final String fwVersion =
038          version.firmwareMajor + "." + version.firmwareMinor + "." + version.firmwareFix;
039
040      // Check PH firmware version
041      if (version.firmwareMajor > 0 && version.firmwareMajor < 22) {
042        throw new IllegalStateException(
043            "The Pneumatic Hub has firmware version "
044                + fwVersion
045                + ", and must be updated to version 2022.0.0 or later "
046                + "using the REV Hardware Client.");
047      }
048    }
049
050    @Override
051    public void close() {
052      REVPHJNI.free(m_handle);
053      m_handleMaps[m_busId.value].remove(m_module);
054    }
055
056    public void addRef() {
057      m_refCount++;
058    }
059
060    public void removeRef() {
061      m_refCount--;
062      if (m_refCount == 0) {
063        this.close();
064      }
065    }
066  }
067
068  @SuppressWarnings({"unchecked", "rawtypes"})
069  private static final Map<Integer, DataStore>[] m_handleMaps =
070      (Map<Integer, DataStore>[]) new Map[PortsJNI.getNumCanBuses()];
071
072  private static final Object m_handleLock = new Object();
073
074  private static DataStore getForModule(CANPort busId, int module) {
075    synchronized (m_handleLock) {
076      Map<Integer, DataStore> handleMap = m_handleMaps[busId.value];
077      if (handleMap == null) {
078        handleMap = new HashMap<>();
079        m_handleMaps[busId.value] = handleMap;
080      }
081
082      DataStore pcm = handleMap.get(module);
083      if (pcm == null) {
084        pcm = new DataStore(busId, module);
085      }
086      pcm.addRef();
087      return pcm;
088    }
089  }
090
091  private static void freeModule(DataStore store) {
092    synchronized (m_handleLock) {
093      store.removeRef();
094    }
095  }
096
097  /** Converts volts to PSI per the REV Analog Pressure Sensor datasheet. */
098  private static double voltsToPsi(double sensorVoltage, double supplyVoltage) {
099    return 250 * (sensorVoltage / supplyVoltage) - 25;
100  }
101
102  /** Converts PSI to volts per the REV Analog Pressure Sensor datasheet. */
103  private static double psiToVolts(double pressure, double supplyVoltage) {
104    return supplyVoltage * (0.004 * pressure + 0.1);
105  }

185  @Override
186  public int checkAndReserveSolenoids(int mask) {
187    synchronized (m_dataStore.m_reserveLock) {
188      if ((m_dataStore.m_reservedMask & mask) != 0) {
189        return m_dataStore.m_reservedMask & mask;
190      }
191      m_dataStore.m_reservedMask |= mask;
192      return 0;
193    }
194  }
195
196  @Override
197  public void unreserveSolenoids(int mask) {
198    synchronized (m_dataStore.m_reserveLock) {
199      m_dataStore.m_reservedMask &= ~mask;
200    }
201  }

224  @Override
225  public boolean reserveCompressor() {
226    synchronized (m_dataStore.m_reserveLock) {
227      if (m_dataStore.m_compressorReserved) {
228        return false;
229      }
230      m_dataStore.m_compressorReserved = true;
231      return true;
232    }
233  }
234
235  @Override
236  public void unreserveCompressor() {
237    synchronized (m_dataStore.m_reserveLock) {
238      m_dataStore.m_compressorReserved = false;
239    }
240  }

247  /**

250   * #enableCompressorHybrid(double, double)} are called.

255  }

262  /**
263   * Enables the compressor in analog mode. This mode uses an analog pressure sensor connected to
264   * analog channel 0 to cycle the compressor. The compressor will turn on when the pressure drops
265   * below {@code minPressure} and will turn off when the pressure reaches {@code maxPressure}.
266   *
267   * @param minPressure The minimum pressure in PSI. The compressor will turn on when the pressure
268   *     drops below this value. Range 0-120 PSI.
269   * @param maxPressure The maximum pressure in PSI. The compressor will turn off when the pressure
270   *     reaches this value. Range 0-120 PSI. Must be larger then minPressure.
271   */
272  @Override
273  public void enableCompressorAnalog(double minPressure, double maxPressure) {
274    if (minPressure >= maxPressure) {
275      throw new IllegalArgumentException("maxPressure must be greater than minPressure");
276    }
277    if (minPressure < 0 || minPressure > 120) {
278      throw new IllegalArgumentException(
279          "minPressure must be between 0 and 120 PSI, got " + minPressure);
280    }
281    if (maxPressure < 0 || maxPressure > 120) {
282      throw new IllegalArgumentException(
283          "maxPressure must be between 0 and 120 PSI, got " + maxPressure);
284    }
285
286    // Send the voltage as it would be if the 5V rail was at exactly 5V.
287    // The firmware will compensate for the real 5V rail voltage, which
288    // can fluctuate somewhat over time.
289    double minAnalogVoltage = psiToVolts(minPressure, 5);
290    double maxAnalogVoltage = psiToVolts(maxPressure, 5);
291    REVPHJNI.setClosedLoopControlAnalog(m_handle, minAnalogVoltage, maxAnalogVoltage);
292  }
293
294  /**
295   * Enables the compressor in hybrid mode. This mode uses both a digital pressure switch and an
296   * analog pressure sensor connected to analog channel 0 to cycle the compressor.
297   *
298   * <p>The compressor will turn on when <i>both</i>:
299   *
300   * <ul>
301   *   <li>The digital pressure switch indicates the system is not full AND
302   *   <li>The analog pressure sensor indicates that the pressure in the system is below the
303   *       specified minimum pressure.
304   * </ul>
305   *
306   * <p>The compressor will turn off when <i>either</i>:
307   *
308   * <ul>
309   *   <li>The digital pressure switch is disconnected or indicates that the system is full OR
310   *   <li>The pressure detected by the analog sensor is greater than the specified maximum
311   *       pressure.
312   * </ul>
313   *
314   * @param minPressure The minimum pressure in PSI. The compressor will turn on when the pressure
315   *     drops below this value and the pressure switch indicates that the system is not full. Range
316   *     0-120 PSI.
317   * @param maxPressure The maximum pressure in PSI. The compressor will turn off when the pressure
318   *     reaches this value or the pressure switch is disconnected or indicates that the system is
319   *     full. Range 0-120 PSI. Must be larger then minPressure.
320   */
321  @Override
322  public void enableCompressorHybrid(double minPressure, double maxPressure) {
323    if (minPressure >= maxPressure) {
324      throw new IllegalArgumentException("maxPressure must be greater than minPressure");
325    }
326    if (minPressure < 0 || minPressure > 120) {
327      throw new IllegalArgumentException(
328          "minPressure must be between 0 and 120 PSI, got " + minPressure);
329    }
330    if (maxPressure < 0 || maxPressure > 120) {
331      throw new IllegalArgumentException(
332          "maxPressure must be between 0 and 120 PSI, got " + maxPressure);
333    }
334
335    // Send the voltage as it would be if the 5V rail was at exactly 5V.
336    // The firmware will compensate for the real 5V rail voltage, which
337    // can fluctuate somewhat over time.
338    double minAnalogVoltage = psiToVolts(minPressure, 5);
339    double maxAnalogVoltage = psiToVolts(maxPressure, 5);
340    REVPHJNI.setClosedLoopControlHybrid(m_handle, minAnalogVoltage, maxAnalogVoltage);
341  }

343  /**
344   * Returns the raw voltage of the specified analog input channel.
345   *
346   * @param channel The analog input channel to read voltage from.
347   * @return The voltage of the specified analog input channel.
348   */
349  @Override
350  public double getAnalogVoltage(int channel) {
351    return REVPHJNI.getAnalogVoltage(m_handle, channel);
352  }
353
354  /**
355   * Returns the pressure read by an analog pressure sensor on the specified analog input channel.
356   *
357   * @param channel The analog input channel to read pressure from.
358   * @return The pressure read by an analog pressure sensor on the specified analog input channel.
359   */
360  @Override
361  public double getPressure(int channel) {
362    double sensorVoltage = REVPHJNI.getAnalogVoltage(m_handle, channel);
363    double supplyVoltage = REVPHJNI.get5VVoltage(m_handle);
364    return voltsToPsi(sensorVoltage, supplyVoltage);
365  }
